_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::particle_dem#2. The DEM normal contact stiffness is an exclusive-or between NORMAL_STIFF and the pair (REL_PENETRATION, MAX_VELOCITY). Both upstream halves run clean; all THREE illegal combinations -- both keys, neither key, and REL_PENETRATION without MAX_VELOCITY -- abort at setup with one byte-identical sentence from 4C_particle_interaction_dem_contact_normal.cpp, so the message cannot tell you which half you got wrong. DISTINCT_MESSAGES=1 is the assertion that measures that directly rather than by proxy: the three logs are grepped for the sentence and the results deduplicated. MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 builds the three broken decks WITHOUT their edit, i.e. three copies of the working stiffauto deck, so the pathology is absent. Unmutated the fixture PASSES; mutated it FAILS because XOR_ABORTS drops to 0, every ABORTED_* becomes 'no', EXIT_BOTH/NONE/NOVMAX become 0 and the quoted sentence is never printed. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 bash cmd.sh`. Executed 2026-08-07 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: specify either the relative penetration along with the maximum velocity, or the normal stiffness, but neither both nor none of them!

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: build the three 'broken' decks straight from the working stiffauto deck, with no edit at all. Every deck is then legal, nothing aborts and the fixture must go red.
